[[File:RebelBaseHadriin2.jpg|200px|thumb|The interior of Garax Hadriin's Rebel Base]]
A '''Rebel Base''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was located in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region of the [[Asworal Everglades]], a considerable distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the base was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garax Hadriin]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Rebel Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] was also affected to this base.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Go to his base and get the information from the computers. While you are at it, take a few of those rebels down. I believe that base's leader is General Garax Hadriin.|[[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]|<ref name="SWG:FtE" />}}
The Rebel Base on Rori was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Base was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either Rebel Officer Wolff Kalos or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Officer [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance. During the hunt for [[Cal Handro]] and the [[Syren spice]] on Rori, Rebel players had to attack an [[Imperial Base (Rori)|Imperial Base]] and kill Imperial General [[Brant Korra]] in order to collect incriminating evidence against Officer M'Kae.<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Rebel|For the Alliance!|Rori}}</ref> If the player instead chose the Empire, he/she would have to attack General Hadriin's base and kill Garax Hadriin to collect information about Wolff Kalos.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
